description: What running the app costs the platform in a month, as an estimate with the breakdown. It is worked out from what the app is made of (whether it has a database, files and scheduled jobs) and a typical month's traffic and deploys, not from its real use. It is not a price, and not what the person is charged. Read-only.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.
